operation.summary: Read what was spent in a namespace: per budget the portion, what is used and when it resets; per source the counts and amounts by state. It answers from the device's journal, with its age

query.name: namespace
query.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build; live is refused with platform_unsupported

operation.returns: budgets[{id, unit, portion, used, remaining, resets_at, standing}], sources{id: {state: {count, counted[]}}}, last_entry_at, age_ms, online, read_at

namespace.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build; live is refused with platform_unsupported
